description: This file defines the TimedNoticeHelper class, which manages the timing and display logic for notices within the app, including tracking how many times a notice has been shown and when to show it next.

classes.name: TimedNoticeHelper
classes.description: A helper class to manage timed notices, determining when to show notices based on preferences and elapsed time.

methods.name: TimedNoticeHelper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the helper with context, preference key, and timing parameters.

methods.name: shouldShow
methods.description: Determines if the notice should be shown based on the current time and the next scheduled show time.

methods.name: markAsShown
methods.description: Updates the state to indicate the notice has been shown, scheduling the next show time.

classes.name: NextTimeProvider
classes.description: Interface for providing the next time offset in milliseconds based on how many times the notice has been shown.

methods.name: TimedNoticeHelper
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the TimedNoticeHelper with a fixed interval between notices.

methods.name: TimedNoticeHelper
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the TimedNoticeHelper with a custom provider for the next show time.

methods.name: shouldShow
methods.description: Checks if the current elapsed real time has reached or surpassed the scheduled next show time.

methods.name: markAsShown
methods.description: Records that the notice has been shown and updates the next scheduled show time accordingly.
